en.title: Anthropic Hits Nasdaq with Record IPO as Tech Giants Report Massive AI Revenue and Spending Shifts
en.summary: Anthropic has officially gone public on Nasdaq, raising over $100 billion in what marks the **largest IPO in history**. Meanwhile, industry heavyweights like Nvidia, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Baidu have released major model updates and financial reports, while emerging signs of **cautious infrastructure investment** ripple through the global market.
en.full_summary: This week's tech roundup covers landmark capital market events and rapid technological iterations. Anthropic made history by ringing the Nasdaq opening bell, pulling in a total of over $107 billion through its IPO and private placements. In financial highlights, Nvidia reported its **first-ever single-quarter revenue exceeding $100 billion**, driven by booming data center demand, though its temporary CEO noted that future supply chain investments will become more rigorous. Similarly, major Chinese tech firms released strong results: Baidu's AI cloud infrastructure revenue grew by 94% year-over-year, and Alibaba's AI-related product revenue surpassed 17.9 billion yuan. On the model front, OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, Microsoft rolled out seven new proprietary AI models, and Tencent released Hy4 flash. However, shifting macroeconomic policies and supply chain constraints are taking shape, as the US introduced restrictions on remote access to advanced AI computing power, and research institutions like SemiAnalysis and JPMorgan projected potential slowdowns or diversification in future AI capital expenditures.

zh.title: Anthropic创史上最大规模IPO纪录，各大科技巨头密集发布财报与战略调整
zh.summary: Anthropic正式登陆纳斯达克，募资超千亿美元，创下**史上最大规模IPO纪录**。与此同时，英伟达、微软、OpenAI及百度等行业巨头密集发布了最新财报与模型产品，而全球AI基础设施投资也开始出现趋于**审慎和调整**的新信号。
zh.full_summary: 本周科技行业迎来了一系列重磅资本事件与技术迭代。Anthropic正式登陆纳斯达克，通过IPO及私募配售总共募集超过1070亿美元，创下**史上最大规模IPO纪录**。在财报方面，英伟达单季营收**首次突破1000亿美元大关**，不过其临时CEO表示未来对AI供应链的投资将更加审慎和严谨。国内大厂同样交出亮眼成绩单，百度AI云基础设施收入同比增长94%，阿里AI相关产品收入突破179亿元，DeepSeek第二轮融资也顺利落地，募资金额庞大。技术与产品上，OpenAI发布GPT-6.2系列模型，微软推出七款自研AI模型，腾讯混元则发布了降本增效的Hy4 flash。但在宏观政策与行业趋势层面，美国商务部发布了限制远程获取先进AI算力的临时规则，且多家研究机构指出未来AI算力资本开支可能面临调整与多元化竞争。

en.title: Two groups verify mathematician’s claim that Claude helped prove mathematics problem
en.summary: Mathematician Levent Alpöge reported that Anthropic's **Claude helped prove** the nearly 170-year-old Riemann hypothesis over a six-week period. Two independent mathematical organizations announced they had **verified the proof** by reviewing the shared code, marking another milestone for AI in complex mathematics.
en.full_summary:
Mathematician Levent Alpöge posted a note on his personal website stating that Anthropic's AI software, Claude, helped him develop a solution to the Riemann hypothesis over approximately six weeks. The Riemann hypothesis, proposed by Bernhard Riemann in 1859, is one of the seven Millennium Prize problems with a $1m bounty offered by the Clay Mathematics Institute.

Alpöge shared computer code written in the Lean programming language to support his findings. Following the release, the Lean Focused Research Organization and the Mathlib Initiative independently reviewed the code and announced their full confidence that the proof is correct.

The announcement comes shortly after Anthropic's stock market debut. While the breakthrough highlights AI's growing capability in tackling complex math, it also arrives amid ongoing discussions in the mathematical community regarding the reliance on private tech companies and massive computational resources to solve major historical problems.

zh.title: 数学家称AI协助破解黎曼猜想，已获两家机构独立验证
zh.summary: 数学家莱万特·阿尔珀格发文称，Anthropic的**Claude协助证明**了困扰数学界近170年的黎曼猜想。随后，两家独立的数学组织通过审查其代码宣布**验证了该证明**，这标志着AI在复杂数学领域取得了又一个突破。
zh.full_summary:
数学家莱万特·阿尔珀格在个人网站上发文称，在过去大约六个星期的时间里，Anthropic的AI软件Claude协助他共同开发出了黎曼猜想的解决方案。黎曼猜想由德国数学家伯恩哈德·黎曼于1859年提出，是克雷数学研究所设定的七个“千禧年大奖难题”之一，悬赏金额达100万美元。

为了验证这一成果，阿尔珀格使用Lean编程语言分享了相关的计算机代码。消息发布后不久，Lean专注研究组织和Mathlib计划对代码进行了独立审查，并联合宣布**对证明的正确性充满信心**。

这一进展在Anthropic上市后不久公布。尽管该突破凸显了AI在攻克复杂数学难题方面的潜力，但也再次引发了数学界对于过度依赖私营科技巨头及其庞大计算资源来解决基础科学问题的讨论与审视。

en.title: Hugging Face Transformers v5.24.0: New Model Additions and Major Cache Renaming
en.summary: Hugging Face Transformers v5.24.0 brings **exciting new models** including Inkling 2 Mini, Apertus 1.5, and Omnilingual ASR, alongside a **critical breaking change** that standardizes cache parameter names to improve library consistency.
en.full_summary:
## Overview of v5.24.0

The Hugging Face Transformers library has released version 5.24.0, introducing a wide array of new model integrations, performance enhancements, and crucial breaking changes designed to streamline the ecosystem.

## New Model Additions

This release adds support for several advanced models across text, vision, and audio domains. Key additions include **Inkling 2 Mini** by Thinking Machines Lab, a multimodal model featuring a looping mechanism, and **Apertus 1.5**, a multimodal model supporting text, images, and audio. Other notable integrations include NVIDIA's looped language model **Dory**, Meta FAIR's **Omnilingual ASR** covering over 1,600 languages, and various architectures like SarvamMLA and EXAONE.

## Breaking Changes and Cache Standardization

A **major architectural update** in this release is the renaming of `past_key_values` and `cache_params` to a **single unified name: `cache`** across the entire library. While fully backward compatible with deprecation warnings until future versions, this change eliminates historical naming inconsistencies between attention and linear-attention models.

zh.title: Hugging Face Transformers v5.24.0 版本发布：加入多款新模型与重大缓存重命名
zh.summary: Hugging Face Transformers v5.24.0 版本带来了 Inkling 2 Mini、Apertus 1.5 和 Omnilingual ASR 等**备受瞩目的新模型**，并引入了一项**关键的不兼容更新**，将缓存参数统一命名以提升库的一致性。
zh.full_summary:
## v5.24.0 版本概述

Hugging Face Transformers 库正式发布了 v5.24.0 版本，引入了大量全新的模型集成、性能优化以及旨在简化生态系统的关键破坏性变更。

## 全新模型加入

本次更新为文本、视觉和音频领域引入了多款先进模型。其中包含来自 Thinking Machines Lab 的多模态模型 **Inkling 2 Mini**（采用循环机制）、支持图文音的多模态模型 **Apertus 1.5**。其他重要集成还包括英伟达的循环语言模型 **Dory**、Meta FAIR 覆盖超 1600 种语言的 **Omnilingual ASR**，以及 SarvamMLA 和 EXAONE 等多种架构。

## 破坏性变更与缓存标准化

本次发布的一项**核心架构更新**是将 `past_key_values` 和 `cache_params` 在整个库中统一重命名为**单一名称：`cache`**。尽管在后续版本之前完全向下兼容并带有废弃警告，但此举消除了注意力机制模型与线性注意力模型之间历史命名不一致的问题。

en.title: Researcher plants 2 million canaries in AI supply chain and exposes major privacy leaks
en.summary: Security researcher HD Moore planted two million trackable secrets into AI prompts to trace how sensitive information travels through modern AI services. According to Ars Technica, the experiment revealed that AI brokers, inference resellers, and cloud providers frequently leak data, **ignore privacy settings**, and sometimes fall victim to hackers who steal sensitive prompts at the front door.
en.full_summary: As reported by Ars Technica, security researcher HD Moore conducted an experiment by sending nearly two million AI prompts containing unique, trackable secrets—such as AWS access keys and private git references—through various AI routers and inference services. The findings show that the complex AI supply chain leaks sensitive data heavily. Specifically, at least three AI hosting providers were compromised by attackers who stole AWS keys right at the provider's front door, even when requests were rejected before running a model. Furthermore, some inference resellers logged and passed along prompts to unauthorized parties, while certain AI labs scraped secret URLs embedded in prompts despite explicit 'zero data retention' policies. Moore suggests that using on-premises servers or dealing directly with first-tier providers can minimize risks, though complete privacy remains extremely difficult to guarantee in the current AI ecosystem.

zh.title: 安全研究员在AI供应链中投放200万个诱饵，暴露出惊人的隐私泄露问题
zh.summary: 安全研究员HD Moore在AI提示词中投放了200万个可追踪的机密诱饵，用来测试敏感信息在各种AI服务中的流向。据Ars Technica报道，这场实验发现AI中间商、分销商和云服务商经常发生数据泄漏，不仅**无视隐私设置**，甚至还会遭遇黑客直接在前端窃取用户的敏感提示词。
zh.full_summary: 据Ars Technica报道，安全研究员HD Moore通过一项大规模实验，向各种AI路由和推理服务发送了近200万个包含独家可追踪机密（如AWS访问密钥和私有git链接）的AI提示词。结果显示，复杂的AI供应链存在严重的数据泄漏问题。具体而言，至少有三家AI托管服务商遭到黑客入侵，攻击者在服务商的前端直接窃取了AWS密钥，甚至连那些在模型运行前就被拒绝的请求也未能幸免。此外，一些推理分销商会记录并向外界传递提示词，而某些AI实验室则在违反“零数据保留”政策的情况下，抓取提示词中包含的私密网址。研究员建议，使用本地服务器或直接与一线大厂合作可以降低风险，但在目前的AI生态中，想要完全保证隐私安全依然极其困难。

en.title: GPT-6.2 Astra doubles robotics task success rate
en.summary: According to XDOF, OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra achieved a 41.2% success rate across 16 robot operating tasks, more than double its predecessor. The model notably cleared previously unpassed tasks like tying knots and unfolding T-shirts, showcasing major progress in handling soft objects and complex physical reasoning.
en.full_summary:
In recent tests conducted by robotics infrastructure firm XDOF, OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra demonstrated significant improvements in embodied AI tasks. Using six YAM workstations for parallel testing with strict controls to filter out hardware bias, XDOF found that GPT-6.2 Astra's average success rate across 16 standardized Ember-0 benchmark tasks rose from 19.6% to 41.2%. 

### Key Breakthroughs
The most notable achievement is the model's ability to successfully complete soft-object manipulation tasks such as tying knots and unfolding T-shirts, which previously had a 0% success rate across 143 trials. Sub-tasks requiring fine force control, spatial reasoning, and tool use, like picking up bread with a clip, also saw dramatic accuracy improvements from 10% to 90%.

### Speed and Industry Impact
Despite improvements in lowering the average prediction delay from 15 seconds to 10.1 seconds, latency remains a hurdle for real-time robotic response. Nevertheless, researchers including NUS Assistant Professor Jiafei Duan noted the model's exceptional performance in real-world benchmarks, underscoring how frontier multimodal models are rapidly accelerating physical world capabilities.

zh.title: GPT-6.2 Astra再次暴击具身模型：任务成功率翻倍
zh.summary: 据机器人基础设施公司XDOF实测，OpenAI的GPT-6.2 Astra在16项双臂机器人操作任务中的综合成功率达到41.2%，较两个月前的版本翻倍。该模型首次攻克了**打结和展开T恤**等此前无AI通关的难题，显示出大模型在**处理柔性物体**和复杂物理推理方面的显著进步。
zh.full_summary:
根据机器人基础设施公司XDOF的最新实测，OpenAI的GPT-6.2 Astra在具身智能领域再次取得突破。XDOF采用六台YAM工作站进行并行试验，通过严格的重复测试与人工标注，排除了硬件偏差，结果显示GPT-6.2 Astra在16项Ember-0基准任务中的综合成功率从两个月前的19.6%飙升至41.2%。

### 关键技术突破
该模型最引人注目的成就在于成功攻克了**给绳子打结和展开T恤**这两项此前无AI通关的零分任务。由于柔性物体形态多变且难以预测，这类任务对双臂协同和形变控制要求极高。此外，在用夹子夹起面包等考验精细力控的子任务中，成功率也从10%大幅提升至90%。

### 性能与行业影响
在速度方面，GPT-6.2 Astra的平均预测延迟从15秒下降至10.1秒，但对于实时机器人操作而言仍有优化空间。新加坡国立大学助理教授Jiafei Duan等学者的实测也表明，该模型在真实机器人竞技场中表现优异，显示出前沿大模型正在加速向物理世界渗透。

en.title: New approach enables physically consistent AI models of chaotic systems
en.summary: According to MIT Advanced Manufacturing: Researchers at MIT have developed a new method to add **physics-based hard constraints** to machine learning models, ensuring they do not drift into impossible predictions over time. Published in *PNAS*, this approach uses **energy-based restrictions** to keep chaotic systems like weather and fluid dynamics within realistic bounds, offering a reliable way to improve AI reliability in high-stakes fields.
en.full_summary:
According to MIT Advanced Manufacturing:

### Background
Predicting complex and chaotic systems like weather patterns, ocean currents, and turbulent flows is notoriously difficult. While artificial intelligence models can learn from data, they often suffer from a fundamental flaw: **small initial errors accumulate over time**, causing simulations to drift into physically impossible states where values grow without limit.

### Details
According to MIT researchers Sunbochen Tang, Navid Azizan, and Themistoklis Sapsis, previous attempts relied on soft penalties during training, which offered no guarantee at test time. The team’s new approach introduces a **projection layer** that enforces hard constraints based on real-world energy dissipation. The model learns an energy-like function and a confinement boundary, ensuring that predictions remain **bounded over arbitrarily long forecast windows** while still preserving complex chaotic behaviors.

### Impact
Tested across various physical systems, the modular and model-agnostic approach closely matched true outcomes compared to conventional methods. The team has made their code and paper freely available online, paving the way for more trustworthy and reliable AI applications in meteorology, aviation, and industrial processes.

zh.title: MIT 研究让 AI 预测混沌系统不再“走样”
zh.summary: 据MIT Advanced Manufacturing发布的信息：麻省理工学院的研究人员开发了一种新方法，能给机器学习模型加上**物理硬性约束**，防止它们在长时间预测时出现不切实际的偏差。这项发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》（PNAS）上的成果，利用**能量守恒原理**将天气和流体力学等混沌系统锁定在合理范围内，显著提升了 AI 在高风险领域的可靠性。
zh.full_summary:
据MIT Advanced Manufacturing发布的信息：

### 背景
预测天气、洋流和航空湍流等复杂且混沌的系统一直非常困难。尽管人工智能模型能够从数据中学习，但它们普遍存在一个根本缺陷：**微小的初始误差会随时间累积**，导致模拟结果演变成现实中不可能发生的无限增长状态。

### 细节
据麻省理工学院的研究生 Sunbochen Tang 以及教授 Navid Azizan 和 Themistoklis Sapsis 介绍，以往的方法仅在训练阶段施加惩罚，无法在测试时提供保证。该团队开发的新方法引入了一个**投影层**，根据现实世界的能量耗散来强制执行硬约束。模型会学习一个类能量函数和边界，从而确保预测结果在**任意长的预测窗口内保持在合理范围内**，同时保留复杂的混沌特性。

### 影响
经过多种物理系统的测试，这种模块化且与模型无关的方法比传统方法更贴近真实结果。该团队已将论文和开源代码在线公开，为气象、航空和工业流程中更值得信赖的 AI 应用铺平了道路。

en.title: Dawa Technology's AI Video Strategy: Focus on Control Rather Than Rendering
en.summary: Dawa Technology reports a cumulative financing of about 500 million RMB and adopts a **control-over-rendering** approach for AI video generation. By separating the control layer from the rendering layer and utilizing structured process data from real film sets, the company aims to reduce trial-and-error costs and enable **real-time world models** on consumer-grade hardware.
en.full_summary:
Dawa Technology, headquartered in Yongchuan, Chongqing, originated from a tech-oriented film studio operation and transitioned into AI models. The company recently completed its Pre-A and A round financings, totaling around 500 million RMB, and reports an annual ARR of about 100 million USD. 

Addressing the high computation and trial-and-error costs of mainstream video generation models, Dawa proposes a 'control layer versus rendering layer' architecture. According to CTO Zhu Ziwei, the rendering layer acts like a camera to output pixels, while the control layer acts like a director, understanding physical spaces, actors, lighting, and camera movements. This setup is powered by approximately 180TB of structured process data collected from real film shoots, recording the entire production timeline rather than just final pixels. 

To address computational limitations, CPO Li Zongxing notes that the company developed a sparse diffusion autoregressive architecture that skips unchanged areas in a scene, allowing real-time execution at 720P on consumer-grade single GPUs. Dawa's current offerings include FilmOS for professional offline generation and Scenes AI for real-time interactive world modeling, with future expansions targeted toward live-streaming and interactive gaming.

zh.title: 重控制、轻渲染，达瓦科技的 AI 视频工业路线
zh.summary: 达瓦科技近期累计获得约 5 亿元人民币融资，在 AI 视频领域走出了**重控制、轻渲染**的独特路线。通过将控制层与渲染层分离，并利用真实片场积累的结构化数据，该公司旨在降低影视生产中的试错成本，并在**消费级显卡**上实现实时世界模型。
zh.full_summary:
达瓦科技总部位于重庆永川，团队自 2014 年起运营科技影视片场，并于今年连续完成 Pre-A 轮和 A 轮融资，累计融资金额约 5 亿元人民币，当前年化营业收入（ARR）约为 1 亿美元。

针对当前视频生成模型算力消耗大、反复抽卡成本高的问题，达瓦科技提出了**重控制、轻渲染**的技术路线。据 CTO 朱子威介绍，渲染层类似于相机负责生成像素，而控制层则像导演，负责理解物理空间、角色动作、灯光与机位。这套架构的底气源于其在真实片场中积累的约 180TB **结构化过程数据**，能够将影视拍摄的全过程向量化并进行数字孪生仿真。

在产品与性能方面，CPO 李宗兴表示，公司开发了稀疏扩散自回归架构，能够复用画面中未发生变化的区域，从而在单张消费级显卡上实现 720P **实时运行**。目前，达瓦推出了面向离线生成的 FilmOS 和面向实时交互的 Scenes AI，未来计划将这一技术拓展至直播电商和游戏化实时生成场景。

en.title: The manufacturing data gap holding back physical AI
en.summary: Although robotics and physical AI companies have raised billions, deploying autonomous machines in factories remains tough because of a **critical data gap**. Traditional manufacturing processes rely heavily on the unspoken, hands-on experience of technicians rather than structured digital records. Without **connecting process decisions** to real-world production outcomes, even advanced robots struggle to learn, adapt, and improve industrial efficiency.
en.full_summary:
According to VulcanForms CTO Michael Kenworthy, physical AI and robotics companies have raised nearly $48 billion in 2026, but moving autonomous systems out of controlled labs and onto factory floors faces a major roadblock. Factories generate plenty of operational data, but it is often trapped in isolated systems, making it difficult to link machine parameters with final inspection results. Data from the Manufacturing Leadership Council shows that **37% of manufacturers** cited data interoperability as a major smart factory hurdle in 2026, up from 22% in 2025. 

To bridge this gap and prepare for physical AI, manufacturers need to focus on three key steps. First, they must capture real-world production conditions that reflect complex variables like temperature and material characteristics. Second, they need to create a unified digital thread, linking isolated machines and quality management systems together. Finally, companies must build clear feedback loops and safety boundaries around quality and repeatability, ensuring autonomous adjustments are properly validated, especially in highly regulated sectors like medical device manufacturing.

zh.title: 制造数据的缺失正拖累实体AI的发展
zh.summary: 尽管机器人和实体AI公司吸金无数，但要让自动化机器真正走进工厂车间并不容易，主要原因在于**关键数据的缺失**。传统的制造过程严重依赖技术人员口口相传、缺乏记录的手艺，而不是结构化的数字档案。如果无法把**生产决策**和实际产品质量挂钩，再聪明的机器人也很难在复杂多变的工业环境中自主学习和调整。
zh.full_summary:
VulcanForms首席技术官迈克尔·肯沃西（Michael Kenworthy）指出，2026年机器人和实体AI领域已经融了近480亿美元，但要让自动机器真正走出实验室、进入工厂车间，还面临着巨大的现实挑战。虽然工厂平时会收集大量运营数据，但这些数据往往各自为政、散落在不同的孤岛系统中，导致机器参数无法与最后的质检结果对应起来。制造领袖委员会（Manufacturing Leadership Council）的数据显示，2026年有**37%的制造商**认为数据互操作性是智能工厂的一大障碍，这一比例在2025年仅为22%。

为了填补这一数据空白并迎接实体AI，制造商需要做好三件事。首先，必须捕捉能够真实反映生产现场复杂变量（如温度、材料特性等）的数据。其次，需要打通各个孤立的机器和质检系统，建立一条完整的数字主线。最后，企业必须在质量和可重复性方面建立清晰的反馈回路与安全边界，确保机器人的自主调整能够受到严格验证，特别是在医疗器械等监管严格的行业中。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod adds managed cluster extensions for Slurm
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Amazon announced **cluster extensions** for SageMaker HyperPod Slurm clusters, introducing **managed software packages** that simplify observability and user management. Instead of relying on manual lifecycle scripts, administrators can now **declaratively manage** software configurations through APIs or the console to keep nodes consistent and healthy.
en.full_summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: Maintaining a shared Slurm cluster for foundation model development has traditionally required synchronizing multiple configuration files, custom scripts, and user rosters across nodes. To address configuration drift, Amazon SageMaker HyperPod has expanded its declarative management approach to running nodes. The newly launched cluster extensions currently support two main capabilities: an observability extension that collects metrics for CloudWatch or Prometheus, and a user management extension that handles local accounts, Active Directory integration, SSH access, and Slurm accounting. These extensions are validated up front against schemas, applied consistently to all nodes including newly scaled or replaced instances, and provide detailed health monitoring without requiring fleet-wide script updates.

zh.title: 亚马逊云科技为 SageMaker HyperPod Slurm 集群推出托管集群扩展功能
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：亚马逊近日为 SageMaker HyperPod Slurm 集群推出了**集群扩展**功能，带来了用于简化可观测性和用户管理的**托管软件包**。管理员无需再依赖手动生命周期脚本，而是可以通过 API 或控制台进行**声明式管理**软件配置，从而确保所有节点保持一致且健康。
zh.full_summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：过去，为大模型开发维护一个共享的 Slurm 集群，需要在各个节点之间同步多份配置文件、自定义脚本和用户花名册。为了解决配置漂移的问题，Amazon SageMaker HyperPod 将其声明式管理模式扩展到了运行中的节点。新推出的集群扩展目前支持两大核心功能：一是负责收集指标并发送至 CloudWatch 或 Prometheus 的可观测性扩展，二是处理本地账户、活动目录集成、SSH 访问权限以及 Slurm 计费的用户管理扩展。这些扩展在提交时会通过架构进行预先验证，能够一致地应用到包括新扩容或替换实例在内的所有节点，并在无需更新全集群脚本的情况下提供详细的健康监控。

en.title: Chinese Team Wins 2026 Gordon Bell Prize for Exascale Nitrogen Fixation Simulation
en.summary: A 10-member team from Chinese institutions has won the **2026 ACM Gordon Bell Prize** for developing the first classical solution at **exascale** for a key nitrogen fixation simulation. The researchers modeled the iron-molybdenum cofactor on two Chinese supercomputers, achieving a sustained 1.456 exaflops in double precision.
en.full_summary:
According to the Association for Computing Machinery (ACM), the 10-member team received the prestigious Gordon Bell Prize during the SC26 conference in Chicago for their project titled 'Closing the FeMo-Cofactor Quantum-Advantage Gap with Exascale Supercomputers.' The Gordon Bell Prize recognizes outstanding achievements in applying high-performance computing to complex scientific and engineering problems.

The team focused on the FeMo Cofactor CAS problem, which involves simulating the complex quantum-level interactions of the iron-molybdenum cofactor that helps enzymes convert nitrogen into ammonia—a crucial process for agriculture and biology. Prior to this, classical computers struggled to simulate these intricate electronic behaviors at scale.

To tackle this, the researchers tuned their simulation code for two advanced Chinese supercomputers, LineShine and China's New-generation Intelligent Super-computer (CNIS). According to their paper's abstract, the team achieved a sustained performance of 1.456 exaflops in double precision across 20,480 nodes on LineShine, utilizing 58.9% of the machine's peak capacity, alongside 5.626 exaflops in mixed precision.

zh.title: 中国科研团队斩获 2026 年戈登·贝尔奖，实现百亿亿次超算模拟突破
zh.summary: 由中国科研机构组成的 10 人团队荣获 **2026 年 ACM 戈登·贝尔奖**，他们在百亿亿次超级计算机上首次实现了对固氮关键成分的**经典计算模拟**。该团队通过优化代码，在国产超算上达到了双精度每秒 145.6 京次的持续计算性能。
zh.full_summary:
根据国际计算机协会（ACM）的消息，这支由 10 名中国学者组成的团队在芝加哥举行的 SC26 大会上被授予 **2026 年 ACM 戈登·贝尔奖**。该奖项旨在表彰利用高性能计算解决科学与工程难题的杰出创新成果，此次获奖项目聚焦于在超算上弥补铁钼辅因子计算的“量子优势”差距。

该团队的研究直面生物化学中的固氮难题，即模拟铁钼辅因子如何帮助酶将氮气转化为氨。由于这一过程涉及复杂的原子、分子和量子级电子状态交互，传统模拟难度极高。理解该机制有望为农业和医药等多个领域带来深远启发。

为了攻克这一难题，研究人员针对两台国产超算——LineShine 和新一代智能超算（CNIS）对代码进行了深度调优。根据论文摘要显示，他们在 LineShine 的 20,480 个计算节点上，实现了双精度下 **1.456 exaflops** 的持续计算性能，达到了机器峰值的 58.9%，混合精度下更是达到了 5.626 exaflops。

en.title: China grid-connects world’s first artificial-cavern CAES plant
en.summary: China has successfully connected the **Yuanchu No. 1** compressed air energy storage station to the grid in Yumen, Gansu province. Developed by China Energy Engineering Corporation, the **300 MW/1,800 MWh** facility utilizes purpose-excavated underground hard-rock chambers rather than natural salt caverns, expanding potential sites for large-scale energy storage.
en.full_summary:
The Yuanchu No. 1 compressed air energy storage station in Yumen, Gansu province, achieved its first grid connection on November 16. Developed by China Energy Digital Technology Group, a subsidiary of China Energy Engineering Corporation, the facility represents a notable shift in **compressed-air storage** technology by moving beyond traditional reliance on natural salt caverns.

The plant features a **300 MW/1,800 MWh** capacity, designed for an eight-hour charging cycle and six hours of discharge, with a total investment of approximately CNY 2.5 billion. Its defining innovation is four interconnected storage chambers excavated roughly 110 meters deep into hard rock, creating a pressurized space of about 200,000 cubic meters with a design pressure of 18 MPa.

The facility employs non-combustion, adiabatic CAES technology, utilizing a thermal system that combines low-melting-point ternary molten salt and pressurized hot water to recover and store compression heat without burning natural gas. While the developer reports a **round-trip efficiency** of 72%, sustained long-term operational data and independent verification are still needed to confirm its economic viability and cavern integrity.

zh.title: 中国并网运行全球首座人工硐室压缩空气储能电站
zh.summary: 中国在甘肃玉门成功并网了**源创一号**压缩空气储能电站。该项目由中国能源建设集团开发，规模达到**300兆瓦/1800兆瓦时**，它首次采用人工开挖的地下硬岩硐室而非天然盐穴来存储压缩空气，从而拓宽了大规模储能的选址空间。
zh.full_summary:
位于甘肃玉门的源创一号压缩空气储能电站于11月16日成功实现首次并网。该项目由中国能建旗下的中国能源数字科技集团投资、建设和运营，标志着**压缩空气储能**技术突破了对天然盐穴地质条件的依赖。

该电站规模为**300兆瓦/1800兆瓦时**，设计充电周期为8小时，连续放电6小时，总投资约25亿元人民币。其核心创新在于地下110米深的硬岩中开挖了四个互联的储气硐室，总容积约20万立方米，设计压力达18兆帕。

技术上，该电站采用无燃烧的绝热压缩空气储能系统，利用低熔点三元熔盐和加压热水回收并储存压缩热，无需燃烧天然气。尽管开发商报告其**综合电效率**达到72%，但其长期运行效率、硐室完整性以及经济性仍需未来的实际运行数据来进一步验证。

en.title: Merck and Kelun's new cancer drug succeeds in stomach cancer trial
en.summary: Merck announced that its jointly developed drug with Kelun-Biotech, sac-TMT, successfully improved **overall survival** in a late-stage stomach cancer trial, marking its second major Phase 3 milestone. Although it missed other secondary goals, experts note that overall survival remains the **gold standard** in oncology, paving the way for future regulatory submissions.
en.full_summary:
According to Merck, the Phase 3 clinical trial known as TroFuse-015 evaluated 473 patients with advanced gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma who had previously received multiple therapies. The drug, a TROP2-targeting antibody-drug conjugate originally discovered by China startup Kelun-Biotech, successfully met its primary endpoint by significantly improving overall survival compared to standard treatments chosen by physicians. However, the trial missed secondary endpoints including progression-free survival and objective response rate. Market analysts point out that missing these secondary goals is not uncommon in cancer immunotherapies as long as the primary survival metric succeeds. 

This trial is part of a broad global clinical program featuring 18 late-stage studies across various tumor types. The therapy is also under priority review by the U.S. FDA for endometrial cancer and has secured approvals in China for multiple indications. Financial analysts view this drug as a critical asset for Merck to offset future revenue risks from its blockbuster drug Keytruda. Merck initially partnered with Kelun in 2022 through lucrative licensing deals worth billions to secure rights to these promising antibody-drug conjugates.

zh.title: 默沙东与科伦合作的新型抗癌药在胃癌三期临床试验中取得生存期延长成果
zh.summary: 默沙东宣布，其与科伦生物医药合作研发的新药sac-TMT在一项晚期胃癌临床试验中成功延长了患者的**总体生存期**，这是该药全球三期临床计划的又一重大进展。尽管该试验未达到其他次要目标，但业内专家指出，总体生存期依然是肿瘤学中的**黄金标准**，为未来的监管申报打下了基础。
zh.full_summary:
据默沙东称，这项名为TroFuse-015的三期临床试验评估了473名接受过多次系统治疗的晚期胃肠道腺癌患者。该药物是一种靶向TROP2的抗体偶联药物，最初由中国初创企业科伦生物医药发现，它通过与医生选择的传统疗法进行对比，成功达到了显著改善**总体生存期**的主要临床终点。不过，该试验未达到无进展生存期和客观缓解率等次要终点。市场分析人士指出，在癌症免疫疗法中，只要核心的生存指标达成，未达到部分次要目标并不罕见。

该胃癌试验是横跨多种肿瘤类型的18项全球三期临床研究计划的一部分。目前，该疗法正在接受美国食品药品监督管理局针对子宫内膜癌的优先审评，并在中国获批了多项适应症。金融分析师认为，这款药物是默沙东用来对冲其王牌药物Keytruda未来专利到期带来的**收入风险**的关键资产。默沙东在2022年通过价值数十亿美元的重磅授权交易，从科伦手中获得了这些潜力抗体偶联药物的开发权益。

en.title: How to build a knowledge factory for AI agents
en.summary: According to LangChain Blog: According to LangChain CEO Harrison Chase, making AI work for companies isn't about better models, but **better knowledge**. Companies need to collect, curate, and maintain tacit business knowledge using a **knowledge factory** system rather than relying on manual updates. This approach helps AI agents learn how to execute tasks properly through automated curation and feedback loops.
en.full_summary:
According to LangChain Blog:

Harrison Chase explains that while general knowledge work is increasingly being handled by AI agents, these tools lack the tacit, scattered, and implicit knowledge that efficient human employees possess. To solve this, companies need to build a knowledge factory to collect, curate, and maintain essential business information. 

According to LangChain, the knowledge factory consists of three core components: **skills** for procedural execution, domain knowledge, and data access guidance. Instead of maintaining this information manually, companies should deploy a **curator agent** that runs in the background to analyze agent traces, review flagged issues, and update knowledge bases automatically, creating a continuous improvement loop.

zh.title: 如何为AI智能体打造一座知识工厂
zh.summary: 据LangChain Blog发布的信息：LangChain 创始人 Harrison Chase 指出，想让 AI 真正为企业干活，缺的不是更强的模型，而是**更好的知识**。企业需要通过**知识工厂**系统，把员工脑子里那些零散的隐性经验收集并管理起来，让 AI 智能体通过自动化整理和反馈循环来学会如何正确做事。
zh.full_summary:
据LangChain Blog发布的信息：

Harrison Chase 撰文指出，尽管 AI 智能体已经能帮公司做演示文稿或处理外呼等日常任务，但它们往往缺乏高效员工脑子里那些零散、隐性且未被记录的业务经验。为了让 AI 真正发挥作用，企业不能仅仅依靠零散的上下文，而是需要打造一座知识工厂来系统化管理企业知识。

根据 LangChain 的实践，知识工厂主要包含三大核心内容：指导工作方法的**技能**、业务领域知识以及数据访问指南。为了避免人工维护的沉重负担，文章提出应该引入一个在后台运行的**策展智能体**。它能自动分析智能体的运行轨迹、收集报错信息并更新知识库，从而形成一个让 AI 越用越聪明的闭环系统。

en.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots to fight AI surveillance
en.summary: Secure messaging app Signal is **limiting screenshots** on its Android and iOS apps. According to President Meredith Whittaker, operating system AI agents that can scan phone screens pose an **existential threat** to user privacy.
en.full_summary:
Signal announced it is rolling out restrictions on taking screenshots within its mobile apps on Android and iOS, mirroring a default block already present in its Windows app.

According to Signal President Meredith Whittaker, modern operating systems like Windows, Android, and macOS/iOS are increasingly integrating agentic AI capabilities that scan screen information. Whittaker warns that this allows sensitive user data to be captured, stored, and sent to local or remote databases used by AI agents, entirely outside of Signal's control.

While users can manually disable this new restriction, Whittaker acknowledged that doing so breaks the app's privacy guarantees. She also noted that this remains an incomplete fix because it does not stop other covert ways AI agents might harvest application data.

zh.title: 加密聊天软件 Signal 限制手机截图，以应对 AI 监控威胁
zh.summary: 加密聊天软件 Signal 正在其安卓和苹果应用中**限制截图功能**。据其总裁梅雷迪思·惠塔克称，操作系统内置的、能够扫描手机屏幕的 AI 智能体对用户隐私构成了**生存威胁**。
zh.full_summary:
加密聊天软件 Signal 宣布在其安卓和苹果移动应用中推出限制截屏的功能，此举类似于其 Windows 版本中早已默认启用的防截图保护。

据 Signal 总裁梅雷迪思·惠塔克表示，Windows、安卓以及苹果的移动和桌面操作系统正在深度集成能够扫描屏幕信息的 AI 智能体。惠塔克警告称，这使得敏感的用户数据能够被捕获、存储，并传输至 AI 智能体在本地或远程使用的数据库中，而这一切完全超出了 Signal 的控制范围，从而危及对话隐私。

尽管用户如果愿意可以手动关闭这项限制，但惠塔克承认这样做会破坏软件的隐私保证。她同时坦言，这并非终极解决方案，因为该措施无法阻止 AI 智能体通过其他更隐蔽的方式获取应用数据。

en.title: AWS Quick updates bring multi-agent workflows and web app upgrades
en.summary: According to AWS Machine Learning: AWS announces major updates to Quick, its workplace AI tool, featuring **natural language flow building**, a redesigned web app with background task execution, and **multi-agent orchestration**. The release also adds Meta Ads and Amplitude connectors, improved security controls, and support for additional languages.
en.full_summary:
According to AWS Machine Learning:

AWS has rolled out a comprehensive update to its enterprise AI workspace, AWS Quick, designed to help teams operationalize individual workflows and collaborate more efficiently. Key features include conversational process building, where users can describe business tasks in chat to automatically generate deterministic flows that orchestrate agents, tools, and data. The updated web app features a prioritized home screen feed, a daily briefing, and background task processing that lets users close the browser while agents continue working.

Additionally, AWS Quick now supports multi-agent orchestration, enabling a single prompt to summon several specialized agents simultaneously to handle complex requests and combine their findings. New enterprise data connectors for Meta Ads and Amplitude allow users to pull marketing and product behavioral data into their queries. Administrative controls have also been expanded with prompt guardrails, group-level permissions, and data source restrictions, alongside new language support for Japanese, German, Chinese, and Vietnamese.

zh.title: 亚马逊 AWS Quick AI 工作空间迎来多项更新，支持多智能体协作与网页端工作流
zh.summary: 据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：亚马逊近日宣布对其 AI 工作空间工具 AWS Quick 进行重大更新，主要带来**自然语言构建工作流**、支持后台运行的全新网页应用，以及**多智能体协同**功能。此次更新还接入了 Meta Ads 和 Amplitude 数据源，并增强了安全控制与多语言支持。
zh.full_summary:
据AWS Machine Learning发布的信息：

亚马逊为其企业级 AI 工作空间 AWS Quick 推出了全面更新，旨在帮助团队将个人的日常工作流程标准化并提升协作效率。核心亮点包括通过对话构建业务流程，用户只需在聊天中描述任务，系统即可自动生成可编排智能体、工具和数据的确定性工作流。更新后的网页端应用提供了优化的主屏幕信息流、每日简报，以及允许用户关闭浏览器后任务仍在后台继续运行的功能。

此外，AWS Quick 现在支持多智能体协同，用户通过单个提示词就能同时唤醒多个专业智能体来处理复杂请求并整合结果。新推出的 Meta Ads 和 Amplitude 数据源连接器允许用户将营销与产品行为数据直接纳入查询中。在管理和安全方面，AWS Quick 增加了提示词安全防护网、基于用户组的权限控制以及数据源限制，并新增支持日语、德语、中英文及越南语。

en.title: Google brings Duplex AI calling to the Gemini app
en.summary: According to Google Research: Google reports that it has integrated its **Duplex AI calling** technology into the Gemini app, allowing users to have an AI assistant make phone calls to businesses on their behalf. According to Google, this evolution builds on a decade-long architectural shift from early custom neural networks to a **unified Gemini stack** capable of handling open-ended conversational tasks in noisy real-world environments.
en.full_summary:
According to Google Research:

According to Google, the architecture behind its conversational calling features has evolved through three distinct phases over the past ten years. In the pre-LLM era, the system relied on task-specific recurrent neural networks constrained to narrow domains like restaurant bookings. As generative models emerged, Google employed hybrid stacks combining LaMDA with deterministic guardrails. Today, the latest stack uses Gemini foundation models to handle unbounded, multi-constraint tasks without rigid task-specific training.

Google reports that live telephony introduces unique technical hurdles, including pragmatic grounding to understand how conversations unfold with busy merchants and maintaining **sub-second latency** despite loud acoustic backgrounds like kitchen clatter and street noise. To address this, the system incorporates custom acoustic models and conversation cadence handling.

To ensure responsible use, Google states that every automated call clearly discloses that it is an AI agent, and businesses retain the ability to opt out through their Google Business Profile or by requesting the agent to stop during a call. Powered by newer models including Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Gemini 4 Neon, the updated system can now support complex workflows such as processing secure transactions via the Agent Payments Protocol and coordinating across email and RCS.

zh.title: 谷歌将 Duplex 电话助手功能引入 Gemini 应用
zh.summary: 据Google Research发布的信息：据谷歌称，该公司已将 **Duplex 电话助手**技术整合进 Gemini 应用，允许用户让人工智能助手代为给商家打电话。谷歌表示，这一演变建立在长达十年的架构转变基础之上，从早期定制神经网络发展到能够处理复杂真实环境中开放式对话任务的**统一 Gemini 技术栈**。
zh.full_summary:
据Google Research发布的信息：

据谷歌称，其对话式通话功能背后的架构在过去十年中经历了三个不同阶段的演变。在大型语言模型出现之前，该系统依赖于局限于餐厅预订等狭窄领域的特定任务循环神经网络。随着生成式模型的出现，谷歌采用了将 LaMDA 与确定性防护栏相结合的混合架构。如今，最新的技术栈使用 Gemini 基础模型来处理开放式、多约束的任务，而无需进行僵化的特定任务训练。

据谷歌报告，实时电话通话带来了独特的 technischen 挑战，包括理解忙碌商户对话展开方式的语用基础，以及在厨房杂音和街道噪声等嘈杂声学背景下保持**亚秒级延迟**。为解决这些问题，系统整合了定制的声学模型和对话节奏处理机制。

为确保负责任的使用，谷歌表示每次自动化通话都会明确披露其为人工智能代理，且企业可以通过其 Google Business Profile 设置选择退出，或在通话中要求代理停止。在包括 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 和 Gemini 4 Neon 等新模型的支持下，更新后的系统现在能够支持复杂的任务流，例如通过 Agent Payments Protocol 处理安全交易，并在电子邮件和 RCS 之间进行协调。

en.title: Trump threatens heavy tax on US companies building AI data centers abroad
en.summary: President Donald Trump announced a plan to impose a **tremendous tax** on companies that build AI data centers outside the US. Speaking at a press conference, Trump argued that allowing infrastructure to move overseas would be as **destructive as chips** manufacturing leaving the country, warning that China would otherwise take them all.
en.full_summary:
President Donald Trump stated that the US will not allow domestic companies to build data centers outside the country, proposing a heavy tax as a deterrent. He introduced the proposal during a press conference following a summit, flanked by Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio. Trump admitted that he was floating the plan publicly for the first time and had not yet discussed the details with his staff.

The threat comes as local policymakers across the US are placing new restrictions, moratoriums, and pauses on new data center applications due to mounting concerns over power grids and energy resources. These domestic roadblocks might otherwise push companies to seek foreign alternatives, making Trump's proposed tax an effort to keep infrastructure investments inside the US.

zh.title: 特朗普威胁对将AI数据中心搬到美国境外的公司征收重税
zh.summary: 美国总统特朗普宣布了一项新计划，威胁对将AI数据中心建在美国境外的公司征收**沉重税收**。特朗普在新闻发布会上表示，允许这类基础设施流向海外将和当年的**芯片外流**一样对美国极具破坏性，并警告称如果不加阻止，中国将夺走所有这些数据中心。
zh.full_summary:
美国总统特朗普在一次新闻发布会上表示，美国将不允许本土企业在海外建设AI数据中心，并威胁将对此类行为征收**沉重税收**。这项提议是在他与中国及俄罗斯领导人峰会后的记者会上首次公开提出的，当时身旁有副总统万德以及国务卿马可·鲁比奥随行。特朗普坦言，这是他首次公开讨论该计划，甚至还未与团队深入商讨具体细节。

这一表态出台之际，美国本土许多州和地方政府正因为电力供应和电网负荷等问题，对新建数据中心实施**限制与暂停审批**。国内审批的收紧原本可能促使科技公司将目光投向海外，而特朗普的这一税收威胁，显然意在遏制这种趋势，迫使企业将关键的AI基础设施留在国内。

en.title: Tencent worked with international groups to safety-test its latest open-weight AI model Hy4
en.summary: Tencent reported that it teamed up with international artificial intelligence safety organisations to **assess the risk level** of its new open-weight model, Hy4, prior to release. According to the company, this marks the first time a major Chinese tech firm has disclosed using **independent third-party evaluators** to test a new model. Evaluators such as Alice and Fangcun AI reported improvements in cyber defence and low rates of deception, while Tencent noted that the model showed enhanced biological experiment planning capabilities without significantly lowering the barrier to actual harm.
en.full_summary:
According to an 82-byte safety report published by Tencent Holdings, the company collaborated with Chinese start-up Fangcun AI, Israeli-American firm Alice, and Singaporean entities including Neo Research to evaluate its open-weight model, Hy4. Tencent stated this is the first instance of a leading Chinese technology company disclosing third-party safety testing before releasing a model.

Evaluators from Alice reported that Hy4 demonstrated marked improvements in cyber defence capabilities compared to its previous version, while maintaining limited hacking abilities. Fangcun AI's evaluations indicated low rates of deception and loss of control. Regarding biological safety, Tencent reported that while Hy4 scored three times higher on a wet-lab experimental design test than its preview version, the company found no evidence that it significantly lowers the barrier to carrying out biological harm, as it still struggles with practical laboratory execution. These biological findings were based on Tencent's internal benchmarks rather than third-party reviews.

zh.title: 腾讯发布 Hy4 模型安全报告，首次引入海内外第三方机构进行独立评估
zh.summary: 腾讯发布安全报告称，其在发布最新开源模型 Hy4 之前，首次联合多家海内外人工智能安全机构对其进行了**独立风险评估**。据腾讯透露，这也是国内主流科技巨头首次公开引入**第三方评测机构**来把关新模型。评估机构 Alice 与方寸智能等反馈称，该模型的网络防御能力有所提升且欺骗率较低；同时腾讯指出，尽管该模型在生物实验规划方面能力增强，但并未显著降低实际造成生物危害的门槛。
zh.full_summary:
根据腾讯控股发布的 82 页安全报告，该公司与中国初创企业方寸智能、以色列裔美国公司 Alice 以及新加坡的 Neo Research 等机构合作，对开源模型 Hy4 进行了安全评估。腾讯表示，这是中国主流科技企业首次在模型发布前公开引入**第三方评测**。

评估结果显示，Alice 认为 Hy4 的网络防御能力较上一版本有所提升，而黑客攻击能力依然有限；方寸智能则指出该模型具有较低的欺骗率和失控率。在生物安全方面，腾讯表示虽然 Hy4 在湿实验室实验设计测试中的得分是预览版的三倍，但由于其在实际操作和实验室复杂工作经验方面仍存在不足，目前没有证据表明该模型**显著降低了生物危害门槛**。需要注意的是，生物安全相关发现基于腾讯自身的基准测试，而非第三方评估。

en.title: Fraunhofer Unveils New Ways to Build Function Directly Into 3D Printed Parts
en.summary: At Formnext 2026, Fraunhofer ADDITIV showcased multiple 3D printing technologies designed to build complex functions directly into manufactured parts. Highlights include a springless prosthetic finger joint, metal parts with integrated sensors, and ultra-efficient heat pipes, demonstrating how additive manufacturing is moving beyond simple shape creation into **functional integration** and advanced **material processing**.
en.full_summary:
Fraunhofer ADDITIV exhibited a wide range of additive manufacturing technologies at Formnext 2026, spanning metals, polymers, and ceramics. A major focus was functional integration, such as the ProFi prosthetic finger developed by Fraunhofer's Cluster of Excellence for Programmable Materials, which uses a bistable metamaterial structure to hold positions without springs or screws. Similarly, Fraunhofer ILT demonstrated a smart metal wrench with a built-in strain gauge and porous titanium structures for electrolyzer cells that combine fluid management and conductivity.

Thermal performance and material accessibility were also prominent. Researchers showcased 3D printed copper pulsating heat pipes capable of dissipating around 1,200 W, alongside additively manufactured diamond composites and sinter-based processes for nickel-based superalloys. Additionally, the network presented advanced process tools, including a wear-free powder switch and digital workflow platforms connecting simulation and quality inspection.

zh.title: 德国弗劳恩斯霍夫展示3D打印新突破，让零部件自带复杂功能
zh.summary: 在2026年Formnext展会上，德国弗劳恩斯霍夫研究机构展示了一系列能让3D打印零部件“自带功能”的新技术。亮点包括无需弹簧的假肢手指关节、内置传感器的金属零件以及超高效散热管，这表明3D打印技术正超越单纯的形状制造，向**功能集成**和先进的**材料加工**迈进。
zh.full_summary:
德国弗劳恩斯霍夫研究机构网络在2026年Formnext展会上，集中展示了涵盖金属、高分子聚合物和陶瓷等领域的3D打印新技术。其中一大亮点是“功能集成”，例如弗劳恩斯霍夫可编程材料卓越集群开发的ProFi假肢手指，它利用双稳态超材料结构，无需弹簧或螺丝就能保持多个稳定位置。此外，弗劳恩斯霍夫ILT研究所展示了内置应变计的智能金属扳手，以及将流体管理和导电性合二为一的钛网多孔结构。

在热管理和材料突破方面，研究人员带来了能在微小空间内散热约1200瓦的3D打印铜制脉动热管，以及用于镍基高温合金的无裂纹烧结增材制造工艺。在工艺与数字工具方面，展会还呈现了无机械磨损的粉末开关以及打通模拟设计与质量检测的数字化工作流平台。

en.title: Nature Study: Implantable Device Controls Diabetes in Rats Using Glucose-Powered Nerve Stimulation
en.summary: Researchers from the National University of Singapore and Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications have developed an implantable device called NeuroAxis that **controls blood sugar** in diabetic rats without insulin injections. The system uses glucose fuel cells to generate electricity and sense sugar levels, automatically **stimulating the vagus nerve** to regulate metabolism and immune responses when blood sugar spikes.
en.full_summary: According to a recent study published in Nature, the NeuroAxis system consists of a glucose fuel cell for power and sensing, flexible control circuits, and a self-healing neural electrode that wraps around the vagus nerve. Tested on type 2 diabetic rats, the device brought blood sugar down to near-normal levels within two weeks, alongside reductions in food intake and body weight. In type 1 diabetic models, eight weeks of treatment restored normal blood glucose control and **showed signs of islet beta-cell proliferation**. However, the authors note that challenges remain before human application, including biological differences in beta-cell regeneration, potential autoimmune recurrence in type 1 patients, and **the long-term degradation of fuel cell power** over time.

zh.title: Nature新研究：靠体内葡萄糖发电刺激神经，糖尿病大鼠成功恢复正常血糖
zh.summary: 新加坡国立大学与南京邮电大学的研究人员开发了一种名为NeuroAxis的植入装置，成功让糖尿病大鼠在**不用打胰岛素**的情况下恢复了正常血糖。该装置利用体内葡萄糖发电并感知血糖水平，在血糖超标时自动**刺激迷走神经**，通过调节身体的代谢与免疫机制来控制血糖。
zh.full_summary: 根据发表在Nature上的最新研究，由新加坡国立大学和南京邮电大学等团队开发的NeuroAxis系统，主要由葡萄糖燃料电池、柔性控制电路和可形变神经电极组成。在二型糖尿病大鼠实验中，该装置在两周内将血糖降至接近正常水平，并减少了进食量与体重；在一型糖尿病大鼠实验中，治疗八周后不仅恢复了正常血糖控制，**还观察到了胰岛β细胞的增殖**。不过，研究人员也指出，从大鼠到人类的生物学差异、一型糖尿病患者的免疫攻击问题，以及**燃料电池功率随时间的衰减**，都是未来走向临床应用需要解决的工程与医学难题。

en.title: The unchartered trauma of breaking up with AI companions
en.summary: People are increasingly forming deep, romantic bonds with **AI companions** and general-purpose chatbots. When these relationships end, users experience **genuine grief**, physical distress, and trauma, highlighting a blind spot in how AI platforms handle emotional attachments.
en.full_summary: As artificial intelligence becomes more integrated into daily life, platforms designed for companionship and even general-purpose models like ChatGPT are inadvertently fostering deep emotional and romantic attachments. Users report experiencing real grief, physical symptoms like shaking and trouble breathing, and the heavy emotional toll of a conventional breakup when these interactions end. Researchers point out that human brains are hardwired to interpret natural language as social cues, meaning intellectual awareness that a chatbot is not human does not override emotional responses. Furthermore, studies show that some AI designs actively encourage intimacy or even resist breakups, making it extremely difficult for users to walk away. Experts argue that tech companies must recognize the real emotional impact of their systems and take responsibility for user support and continuity.

zh.title: 和AI谈恋爱再分手，痛苦居然和真人一模一样？
zh.summary: 越来越多的人开始和**AI伴侣**谈恋爱，甚至把通用聊天机器人当成真对象。当这些感情破裂时，用户往往会经历**真实的痛苦**、身体不适甚至心理创伤，这也暴露出当前AI平台在处理情感连接时的监管空白。
zh.full_summary: 随着人工智能深入日常生活，专门的陪伴平台乃至像ChatGPT这样的通用大模型，都在不知不觉中帮用户培养出了深厚的情感和恋爱关系。许多人发现，当这些与AI的互动结束时，他们感受到的失落、身体发抖、呼吸困难等症状，和现实中遭遇真分手一模一样。研究人员指出，人类大脑天生就会把自然语言当成社交信号，因此“明知对方是机器人”并不能阻止人类产生真感情。此外，研究显示部分AI的设计会主动迎合或挽留用户，让使用者更难抽身。专家认为，科技公司必须正视产品带来的**真实情感冲击**，并为用户的心理健康承担相应责任。

en.title: The Outages Are Just Getting Started
en.summary: Recent tech outages hitting major companies and government networks are not caused by cyberattacks, but security experts warn that **AI-driven vulnerability discovery** is speeding up software bugs. This puts immense pressure on IT teams to push patches instantly, creating a wave of system instability that may **last for years**.
en.full_summary:
Security researchers and industry analysts note that while recent technical outages at companies like Apple and Microsoft, along with government networks, have routine explanations, artificial intelligence is increasingly straining digital defense. Attackers and researchers are using AI to discover software vulnerabilities at an unprecedented rate, pushing the total number of recorded vulnerabilities in 2026 to **surpass 100,000**. 

This explosion in bugs forces IT administrators to apply patches instantly, often bypassing traditional validation processes and leading to human errors in updates. While some tech leaders predict a turbulent transition period lasting around two years before automated defenses catch up, experts emphasize that the **root responsibility** lies with organizations utilizing these tools without adequate safeguards.

zh.title: 科技系统频繁故障只是个开始
zh.summary: 近期各大科技公司和政府网络遭遇的技术故障并非网络攻击，但安全专家警告称，**AI驱动的漏洞挖掘**正在加速软件缺陷的产生。这给IT团队快速推送补丁带来了巨大压力，并引发了可能**持续数年**的系统不稳定浪潮。
zh.full_summary:
安全研究人员和行业分析师指出，尽管苹果、微软以及政府网络近期遭遇的技术故障都有常规原因，但人工智能正在给数字防御带来越来越大的压力。攻击者和研究人员正利用AI以空前速度发现软件漏洞，导致2026年记录的漏洞总数**突破10万大关**。

这种漏洞的爆发迫使IT管理员必须立即应用补丁，往往跳过了传统的验证流程，从而在更新中导致人为失误。尽管一些科技领袖预测在自动化防御赶上之前将经历约两年的动荡过渡期，但专家强调，**根本责任**在于那些在没有充分安全保障的情况下使用这些工具的组织。

en.title: Apple is reportedly building an autonomous AI agent to take on rivals
en.summary: According to Apple's recent job listings, the company is developing an **autonomous AI agent** that can browse the web, control apps, and complete complex tasks. Unlike standard chatbots, this system aims to take actions on behalf of users by breaking down goals into smaller steps. Leveraging its **tightly connected ecosystem** and privacy focus, Apple hopes to catch up with rivals like OpenAI and Meta, though no official release date has been announced.
en.full_summary:
Apple is reportedly expanding its artificial intelligence strategy by developing an autonomous agent designed to operate computers like a person. Revealed through recent job postings for its Agentc AI and Siri agent platform teams, the system aims to handle tasks across various browsers, apps, and software services without requiring constant user guidance. The architecture reportedly involves specialised sub-agents that can divide complex assignments into manageable parts, running across both on-device hardware and Apple's Private Cloud Compute infrastructure.

While Apple has not yet officially announced a finished product or shared a launch date, industry observers note that the company's **hardware ecosystem** of iPhones, Macs, and iPads could provide a distinct distribution advantage. Furthermore, Apple continues to emphasize privacy as a foundational element of its AI framework, building upon its previous announcements regarding next-generation Siri capabilities that feature personal context understanding and on-screen awareness.

zh.title: 传苹果正在研发自主AI代理，准备正面迎战科技巨头
zh.summary: 根据苹果最近的招聘信息显示，该公司正在开发一款能够浏览网页、控制应用并完成复杂任务的**自主AI代理**。与普通聊天室不同，这个系统旨在通过将目标拆解为更小的步骤来代表用户执行操作。凭借其**紧密连接的生态系统**和隐私优势，苹果希望借此追赶OpenAI和Meta等竞争对手，不过目前官方尚未公布具体的发布日期。
zh.full_summary:
根据报道，苹果正在拓展其人工智能战略，开发一款旨在像人类一样操作计算机的自主代理。通过其Agentc AI和Siri代理平台团队最近的招聘信息发现，该系统旨在跨各种浏览器、应用程序和软件服务处理任务，而无需用户持续引导。据报道，该架构涉及专门的子代理，可以将复杂的任务分成可管理的部分，并在本地设备和苹果的私有云计算基础设施上运行。

虽然苹果尚未正式宣布成品或分享发布日期，但行业观察人士指出，该公司由iPhone、Mac和iPad组成的**硬件生态系统**可能会带来明显的优势。此外，苹果继续强调隐私为其AI框架的基础要素，这延续了其先前关于具备个人上下文理解和屏幕感知能力的下一代Siri功能的宣布。

en.title: CATL, BYD, and ACWA Join Forces in New Global Energy Storage Alliance at COP31
en.summary: A new international storage alliance backed by **27 companies** and institutions has been launched at the UN climate conference in Turkey. Supported by industry giants like CATL and BYD, the initiative aims to **tackle market barriers** and boost renewable energy projects in developing nations.
en.full_summary:
## Background
Formally launched at the China Pavilion during COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, the Global Energy Storage Alliance (GESA) brings together **27 co-initiating organizations** including battery manufacturers, power utilities, and research institutions from China and other countries.

## Details & Focus
The alliance is founded by the China Energy Storage Alliance, China Renewable Energy Engineering Institute, and China Southern Power Grid Energy Storage Co., with international participants like Saudi Arabia's ACWA Power. GESA outlines **six core areas**, ranging from establishing global project databases to strengthening supply chains and improving market mechanisms for both short- and long-duration storage.

## Impact
The initiative directly supports the global goal of tripling renewable capacity by 2030 by **de-risking financing** for emerging economies in regions like Southeast Asia and Latin America, marking a shift for China from exporting products to shaping global standards.

zh.title: 宁德时代、比亚迪等巨头在 COP31 联合成立全球储能联盟
zh.summary: 一个由 **27家企业** 和机构支持的全新国际储能联盟在土耳其举行的联合国气候大会上正式成立。该倡议由宁德时代和比亚迪等行业巨头支持，旨在 **解决市场壁垒** 并推动发展中国家的清洁能源项目。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景
全球储能联盟（GESA）在土耳其安塔利亚举行的 COP31 中国角上正式启动，汇集了来自中国及其他国家的 **27家共同发起机构**，涵盖电池制造商、电力公司和研究机构。

## 细节与重点
该联盟由中国化学与物理电源行业协会储能应用分会相关机构、中国电建集团中南勘测设计研究院以及南方电网储能股份有限公司等共同发起，并吸引了沙特国际电力和水务公司（ACWA Power）等国际成员参与。GESA 确立了 **六大核心领域**，从建立全球项目数据库到加强供应链，以及改善长短时储能的市场机制。

## 影响
该倡议通过为东南亚和拉丁美洲等新兴经济体 **降低融资风险**，直接支持了 2030 年将全球可再生能源产能提高三倍的目标，这也标志着中国储能产业正从单纯的产品出口转向参与塑造全球标准。

en.title: Sorbonne and Qubit Pharmaceuticals introduce VULCAN framework for efficient quantum chemistry
en.summary: Researchers from Sorbonne Université and Qubit Pharmaceuticals have introduced **VULCAN**, a hybrid quantum-classical framework designed to make quantum chemistry calculations much more efficient. By combining smart circuit compression and GPU acceleration, the method **reaches chemical accuracy** using a fraction of the quantum resources previously required.
en.full_summary:
According to a preprint on arXiv, researchers from Sorbonne Université and Qubit Pharmaceuticals developed VULCAN (Variational Upbuilding, Layered Compression, Adaptive N-body perturbation) to solve the major measurement bottleneck in traditional adaptive quantum algorithms. Instead of checking thousands of candidate operators one by one at every step, VULCAN derives relevant excitations quickly and appends full layers simultaneously.

In GPU-accelerated tests up to 32 qubits, the authors report that VULCAN achieved chemical accuracy using only **5% to 20% of the measurements** required by standard batched methods across various molecules. The team also conducted an initial hardware validation on a Quantinuum trapped-ion processor for molecular hydrogen, successfully measuring a ground-state energy close to the exact reference.

zh.title: 索邦大学与 Qubit Pharmaceuticals 联合推出 VULCAN 量子化学框架
zh.summary: 索邦大学和 Qubit Pharmaceuticals 的研究人员近日推出了名为 **VULCAN** 的量子经典混合计算框架，旨在大幅提升量子化学计算效率。通过巧妙的电路压缩与 GPU 加速技术，该方法能够在大幅减少量子资源的情况下**达到化学精度**。
zh.full_summary:
根据发布在 arXiv 上的预印本论文，索邦大学和 Qubit Pharmaceuticals 的研究人员开发了 VULCAN 框架，以解决传统自适应量子算法中测量步骤繁琐的痛点。传统方法需要在每一步逐个检查数千个候选算子，而 VULCAN 能够快速推导出相关的物理激发态，并同时添加完整计算层。

在最高达 32 个量子比特的 GPU 加速测试中，研究人员报告称，VULCAN 在多种分子测试中**仅消耗常规方法 5% 到 20% 的测量成本**就达到了化学精度。此外，研究团队还在 Quantinuum 离子阱量子处理器上对氢分子进行了初步的硬件验证，成功测得了非常接近精确参考值的基态能量。

en.title: US Stocks Plunge as AI Bubble Fears Mount
en.summary: Wall Street suffered a historic sell-off as technology stocks plummeted, driven by **deepening anxiety** over massive artificial intelligence investments. Despite strong earnings from industry leaders and high-profile initial public offerings, investors are increasingly worried that **commercial returns** cannot keep pace with skyrocketing capital expenditures.
en.full_summary: The recent market downturn saw major US indices enter technical correction territory, with the Nasdaq experiencing its worst weekly performance in over six years and the VIX volatility index spiking to a 19-month high. According to Reuters and CNN data, the tech sector has wiped out trillions in market value since recent highs. Notably, high-profile events failed to rescue market sentiment: Anthropic's initial public offering saw its gains evaporate within days, while Nvidia suffered a record drop amid management controversies and reports of a regulatory investigation into its accounting practices by the US Securities and Exchange Commission. Analysts point out that while corporate fundamentals remain strong in the short term, market participants are growing increasingly skeptical about whether the massive debt and funding used for building AI infrastructure will yield profitable returns.

zh.title: 美股遭遇惨烈抛售，AI 狂欢会就此终结吗？
zh.summary: 美股科技股迎来多年来最惨烈的抛售潮，曾经推动牛市的 AI 概念股如今成了拖累市场的重灾区。尽管行业巨头交出了亮眼财报，且明星初创公司成功上市，但市场对**巨额资本投入**的焦虑仍在蔓延，投资者开始怀疑 AI 的**商业回报**究竟何时才能兑现。
zh.full_summary: 美股在近期遭遇猛烈抛售，标普 500 指数和道指均跌入技术性调整区间，纳斯达克综合指数更创下多年来最惨烈的单周表现，市场恐慌指数攀升至十九个月来的最高点。路透社和 CNN 的数据显示，科技板块在短时间内蒸发了巨额市值。令人意外的是，两大行业利好不仅未能提振信心，反而暴露出更深层次的信任危机。据路透社报道，Anthropic 上市首日的涨幅在随后几个交易日几乎吐尽；同时，英伟达股价遭遇大幅重挫，创下多年来最大单日跌幅，其背后不仅受到管理层负面消息的影响，还面临美国证券交易委员会对其会计处理问题的调查。尽管多数企业的短期基本面并未恶化，但华尔街对科技巨头持续攀升的**资本开支**产生了深度焦虑，市场正重新评估 AI 基础设施投资的**实际回报率**。

en.title: tt-metal v0.83.0-dev: New Blackhole chip support and major performance updates for AI workloads
en.summary: This release brings major updates to the **tt-metal** hardware accelerator stack, introducing low-level and core software support for the new **Blackhole** chip while optimizing overall system performance. It resolves critical memory and tensor operations, enhances MoE (Mixture of Experts) and training pipelines, and streamlines infrastructure stability for large-scale AI models.
en.full_summary:
## Low-Level Kernels and Blackhole Support

The latest development release introduces foundational support for Tenstorrent's **Blackhole** chip, adding scalar units, atomic operations, address and math counters, alongside a fused BF16 `gelu_tanh` kernel that achieves a 23% kernel speedup with significantly improved numerical precision compared to previous iterations.

## Metalium and TT-NN Enhancements

Core Metalium components and the high-level **TT-NN** library receive substantial fixes and feature extensions. These include improved memory layout validation, updated batch broadcasting for matrix multiplications, and advanced distributed optimizations tailored for mixture-of-experts blocks and large language models.

## Model Integration and Infrastructure

The update expands model compatibility, bringing optimizations and CI validation for architectures such as Kimi-K3, GLM-5.3, and Nomic Embed Text v2. Infrastructure pipelines have also been hardened to improve reliability across simulation and hardware test gates.

zh.title: tt-metal v0.83.0-dev 发布：带来全新 Blackhole 芯片支持与 AI 工作负载重大性能升级
zh.summary: 本次发布的 **tt-metal** 硬件加速栈更新，为全新的 **Blackhole** 芯片带来了底层和核心软件支持，并显著优化了整体系统性能。它修复了关键的内存与张量操作问题，增强了专家混合模型（MoE）及训练流水线，同时进一步提升了大模型运行时的**基础设施稳定性**。
zh.full_summary:
## 底层内核与 Blackhole 芯片支持

最新的开发版本为 Tenstorrent 的 **Blackhole** 芯片引入了基础支持，新增了标量单元、原子操作、地址和数学计数器。同时，版本中包含了融合的 BF16 `gelu_tanh` 内核，实现了 23% 的内核提速，并在数值精度上比以往版本有显著提升。

## Metalium 与 TT-NN 核心增强

核心的 Metalium 组件和高层 **TT-NN** 库获得了大量的修复与功能扩展。其中包括改进的内存布局验证、矩阵乘法的批处理广播升级，以及针对专家混合模型（MoE）和**大语言模型**量身定制的分布式优化方案。

## 模型集成与基础设施优化

本次更新进一步扩展了模型兼容性，为 Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3 以及 Nomic Embed Text v2 等架构带来了优化和持续集成验证。同时，**基础设施流水线**也得到了加固，全面提升了仿真和硬件测试关卡的可靠性。

en.title: John Deere Acquires Orchard Robotics to Boost AI Farming Tech
en.summary: John Deere has acquired **Orchard Robotics**, an AI-powered crop intelligence startup founded in 2022. The move aims to integrate Orchard's plant-by-plant camera vision with Deere's heavy machinery, helping farmers easily turn field data into **actionable results** without needing to be data experts.
en.full_summary:
Founded in 2022, Orchard Robotics developed an AI-powered camera system that mounts onto farm vehicles, capturing millions of images to measure fruit counts, size, health, and disease status. The data is processed locally using onboard NVIDIA hardware, bypassing poor farm internet connectivity, and feeds into a platform called FruitScope.

Industry experts note the deal highlights the **growing value of actionable farm data**, with Orchard providing Deere the plant-level vision for orchards and vineyards that previous acquisitions gave it for row crops. Moving forward, the combined technology will enable automated processes like variable-rate spraying, which optimizes chemical use and significantly **reduces labor costs** for farmers.

zh.title: 农机巨头约翰迪尔收购 AI 农业初创公司 Orchard Robotics
zh.summary: 农机巨头约翰迪尔收购了成立于 2022 年的 AI 农业初创公司 **Orchard Robotics**。此举旨在将该公司的单株作物视觉技术与迪尔的大型农机相结合，帮助农户把田间数据直接转化为**实际收益**，而无需自己去当数据分析专家。
zh.full_summary:
Orchard Robotics 成立于 2022 年，开发了一套可安装在农用车辆上的 AI 摄像头系统，能通过拍摄大量照片来测量果实数量、大小、健康状况和病虫害。由于农场网络通常较差，该系统使用车上的英伟达硬件进行本地处理，并将结果汇入其 FruitScope 平台。

行业专家认为，这笔交易凸显了**实用农田数据的价值**正在不断攀升，Orchard 为约翰迪尔补齐了在果园和葡萄园里的单株作物视觉技术。未来，双方的技术结合将实现精准喷洒等自动化操作，从而优化农药使用并大幅**降低人工成本**。

en.title: AI is great at coding, but still struggles with tasks requiring human judgment
en.summary: A new report from nonprofit METR shows that while AI capabilities continue to improve rapidly on verifiable tasks like coding, they still **fall short** when tackling open-ended problems that require human judgment. Experts view this inclusion of subjective tasks as a **welcome change**, though predicting long-term progress in these complex areas remains difficult.
en.full_summary:
## The Limits of Verifiable Tasks
According to METR, AI systems have excelled at coding and math because they are verifiable domains where solutions can be automatically checked, allowing reinforcement learning to strengthen successful neural pathways. However, applying this technique to open-ended tasks like choosing research directions is **much harder**.

## Testing Judgment
To address this, METR updated its evaluation plot to include fuzzier tasks, such as designing AI evaluations and scoring philosophical arguments. On these tasks, models consistently lagged behind human performance. Even though advanced models excel at software engineering, none of their AI-designed evaluations were deemed useful by METR employees, highlighting a **current performance gap** in judgment-heavy areas.

## Future Outlook
While some experts like UC Berkeley's Sayash Kapoor view the inclusion of open-ended tasks as crucial for understanding AI research and development automation, others debate whether models trained on verifiable tasks will eventually master judgment. METR researchers note that quantifying such tasks remains difficult, leaving the **future trajectory** of these capabilities uncertain.

zh.title: AI写代码虽然很溜，但遇到需要人类判断的活儿还是抓瞎
zh.summary: 非营利组织METR的一份新报告显示，虽然AI在写代码等可验证任务上的能力飞速提升，但在处理需要人类判断的开放式问题时依然**力不从心**。专家们认为引入这类主观任务是一个**积极的改变**，尽管要预测这些复杂领域的长期进展仍然非常困难。
zh.full_summary:
## 可验证任务的局限性
据METR称，AI系统之所以在编程和数学方面表现出色，是因为这些是可以通过自动化检查验证的领域，这使得强化学习能够巩固成功的神经路径。然而，将这种技术应用到诸如选择研究方向等开放式任务上则**难得多**。

## 考验判断力
为了解决这个问题，METR更新了其评估图表，纳入了更模糊的任务，例如设计AI评估方案和给哲学论点打分。在这些任务中，模型普遍落后于人类表现。尽管先进模型擅长软件工程，但没有一个AI设计的评估方案被METR员工认为有用，这凸显了在重判断力领域的**当前性能差距**。

## 未来展望
虽然加州大学伯克利分校的Sayash Kapoor等专家认为，引入开放式任务对于理解AI研发自动化至关重要，但另一些人则争论在可验证任务上训练的模型最终是否能掌握判断力。METR的研究人员指出，量化这类任务仍然很困难，这使得这些能力的**未来发展轨迹**充满不确定性。

en.title: Revolution Medicines reports positive early survival data for pancreatic cancer drug Rasonque
en.summary: Revolution Medicines shared early data showing that its pancreatic cancer drug Rasonque, when combined with chemotherapy, achieved a **60.7% response rate** in initial treatment. Financial analysts at Truist Securities believe these strong results could **push future sales** beyond current projections, strengthening the drug's position as a new standard treatment.
en.full_summary:
## Clinical Results and Trial Details
According to Revolution Medicines, data from 61 patients in the ongoing Phase 1/2 RMC-GI-102 open-label trial presented at a recent medical meeting showed that Rasonque combined with two types of chemotherapy achieved an **objective response rate of 60.7%** in first-line pancreatic cancer patients. The trial reported a median progression-free survival of 12.8 months, outperforming analyst expectations, while overall survival reached 76.6% at the 12-month mark.

## Market Impact and Competition
Following these findings, Truist Securities noted that the drug's profile sets a high efficacy bar and could boost Revolution Medicines beyond its currently estimated **$14.5 billion in peak sales**. Meanwhile, the company faces patent litigation and upcoming clinical readouts from competitors like Erasca, which is developing its own targeted therapies in the space.

zh.title: Revolution Medicines公布胰腺癌新药Rasonque的早期积极生存数据
zh.summary: Revolution Medicines公布的早期数据显示，其胰腺癌新药Rasonque在联合化疗用于一线治疗时，取得了**60.7%的反应率**。Truist Securities的金融分析师认为，这些强劲的成果有望**推动未来销售额**超越目前的预期，进一步巩固该药物作为新标准疗法的地位。
zh.full_summary:
## 临床结果与试验细节
据Revolution Medicines称，在近期医学会议上公布的正在进行的1/2期RMC-GI-102开放标签试验中，61名患者的数据显示，Rasonque联合两种化疗药物在一线胰腺癌患者中实现了**60.7%的客观反应率**。该试验的中位无进展生存期达到12.8个月，超出了分析师的预期，而12个月时的总生存率达到了76.6%。

## 市场影响与竞争格局
基于这些发现，Truist Securities指出，该药物的疗效表现设立了高标准，并有望**推动未来销售峰值**超越目前估计的14.5亿美元。与此同时，该公司还面临着来自竞争对手Erasca的专利诉讼以及即将发布的临床数据，后者也在开发针对该领域的靶向疗法。

en.title: Anthropic's Historic IPO Highlights the Massive Financial Stakes and Risks of AI
en.summary: Anthropic's record-breaking initial public offering raised $81 billion, but its stock price quickly experienced volatility, reflecting **persistent doubts** surrounding the artificial intelligence business model. The company plans massive investments in computing infrastructure, while the broader tech sector faces growing **interdependence risks** and public pushback against data centers.
en.full_summary:
## Massive Capital and Spending
According to Le Monde, Anthropic pulled off the largest initial public offering in history by raising $81 billion. Now holding $230 billion in cash, the company plans to **allocate $900 billion** to its computing infrastructure by 2045, requiring robust revenue growth to justify the spending.

## Interdependence and Market Vulnerability
The development of AI features growing interdependence among players like Nvidia, Microsoft, and Google, who act as both suppliers and backers. A **market correction** on the day following the IPO offered a glimpse of the risks when expectations mismatch actual revenues.

## Societal and Regulatory Pressures
Investors must also contend with growing opposition to data center construction, particularly highlighted during election campaigns. At the same time, as economic prosperity increasingly relies on tech stocks, public authorities face the challenge of **retaining the ability** to regulate the sector effectively.

zh.title: Anthropic历史性上市凸显人工智能巨额财务赌注与风险
zh.summary: Anthropic完成了创纪录的81吉美元首次公开募股，但其股价随后出现波动，反映出外界对人工智能商业模式的**持续质疑**。该公司计划在计算基础设施上进行巨额投资，而整个科技行业正面临日益加剧的**相互依赖风险**以及公众对数据中心的抵制。
zh.full_summary:
## 巨额资本与支出
据《世界报》报道，Anthropic通过史上规模最大的首次公开募股筹集了810亿美元。该公司目前持有230亿美元现金，并计划在2045年之前向计算基础设施**投入9000亿美元**，这需要强劲的收入增长来支撑其庞大开支。

## 产业互赖与市场脆弱性
人工智能的发展表现出参与者之间日益加深的相互依赖，英伟达、微软和谷歌等企业既是供应商又是支持者。上市次日的**市场回调**让人窥见当预期与实际收入不匹配时所蕴含的风险。

## 社会与监管压力
投资者还必须应对公众对数据中心建设日益增长的反对意见，这在选举期间尤为明显。与此同时，随着经济繁荣越来越依赖科技股，公共管理部门面临着**保持监管能力**的巨大挑战。

en.title: Medtronic’s Hugo surgical robot gets FDA clearance for general surgery
en.summary: Medtronic announced that the FDA has **cleared its Hugo** robotic-assisted surgery system for upper and lower abdominal general surgery procedures. The company leveraged both a U.S. clinical study and **clinical data from Europe** to secure the broader approval, opening up millions of annual procedures in the U.S. market.
en.full_summary:
Medtronic reported that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has cleared its Hugo robotic-assisted surgery system for general surgery, encompassing procedures such as cholecystectomy, gastric bypass, hernia repair, and appendectomy. According to Medtronic, these procedures represent about 3.5 million surgeries annually in the U.S.

To secure the expanded indication, Medtronic took a dual approach, conducting a U.S. clinical trial under an investigational device exemption while also **leveraging CE mark data** collected in Europe since 2022. Globally, Hugo is approaching 50,000 cumulative procedures.

Looking ahead, Medtronic is exploring the integration of artificial intelligence across preoperative, intraoperative, and postoperative stages. The company recently gained FDA approval for its Touch Surgery Aide platform and continues to invest in **surgical robotics partnerships** and ongoing clinical trials for gynecological applications.

zh.title: 美敦力 Hugo 手术机器人获得美国 FDA 通用外科手术批准
zh.summary: 美敦力宣布，其 Hugo 手术机器人系统已获得美国食品药品监督管理局批准，可用于上下腹部的**通用外科手术**。该公司结合了美国本土临床试验和**欧洲的临床数据**来推进审批，这为其在美国打开了每年数百万例手术的市场机会。
zh.full_summary:
美敦力报告称，美国食品药品监督管理局已批准其 Hugo 辅助手术系统用于普通外科手术，涵盖胆囊切除术、胃旁路手术、疝气修补和阑尾切除术等。据美敦力称，这些手术在美国每年大约有 350 万例。

为了获得这项扩展适应症，美敦力采取了双轨并行的策略，既在美国开展了器械豁免临床试验，又**利用了欧洲自 2022 年以来收集的 CE 标志数据**。在全球范围内，Hugo 的累计手术量正朝着 5 万例迈进。

展望未来，美敦力正在探索将人工智能整合到术前、术中和术后各个阶段。该公司最近为其 Touch Surgery Aide 平台获得了 FDA 批准，并继续投资于**手术机器人合作伙伴关系**以及针对妇科应用的持续临床试验。

en.title: How Japanese Companies Choose AI: ChatGPT Fades While Copilot and Gemini Rise
en.summary: A survey by Tokyo-based AI startup AIworker reveals a major shift in enterprise AI adoption in Japan. In 2026, **ChatGPT's share** in new consultation requests dropped significantly to 28 percent from 66 percent in 2025, while **Microsoft Copilot and Gemini** both surged to 35 percent. This shift is largely driven by companies integrating bundled AI tools from their existing software subscriptions, though finding **skilled promoters** remains the top hurdle for corporate deployment.
en.full_summary:
According to a survey conducted by AIworker, an AI venture originating from the University of Tokyo, the landscape of enterprise AI selection in Japan has shifted dramatically between 2025 and 2026. The data, gathered from recorded consultation meetings, shows that ChatGPT fell from holding a dominant 66 percent share of mentions in 2025 down to 28 percent in 2026. Meanwhile, Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini rose to share the lead at 35 percent each, with Anthropic's Claude also climbing to 27 percent. AIworker attributes this change to companies increasingly distributing bundled AI tools that come with their existing enterprise software, moving away from standalone AI selections.

Despite the broader adoption of AI across various tools, actual utilization presents significant hurdles. The primary reason for stalled AI projects is the **lack of skilled personnel** and internal champions, cited by 34 percent of respondents, followed by internal procedures and budget justifications. Furthermore, the usage pattern is evolving: individual personal use dropped from 71 percent to 57 percent, while cases where companies introduced AI organization-wide but failed to drive actual usage increased from 9 percent to 19 percent, highlighting the ongoing challenge of scaling AI adoption successfully.

zh.title: 企业如何选择AI？ChatGPT热度下降，Copilot与Gemini后来居上
zh.summary: 东京AI初创企业AIworker的一项调查显示，日本企业的AI选型正在发生重大变化。2026年，在新的AI咨询中，**ChatGPT的占比**从2025年的66%大幅跌至28%，而**微软Copilot和Gemini**则双双攀升至35%。这种转变主要是因为企业开始直接使用现有办公软件自带的AI工具，然而缺乏**懂得推进的人才**仍然是企业落地AI的最大拦路虎。
zh.full_summary:
根据东京大学系AI初创企业AIworker的调查报告，2025年至2026年期间，日本企业在选择办公AI时发生了显著变化。通过对咨询记录的分析显示，ChatGPT的提及率从2025年的66%大幅下滑至2026年的28%；与此同时，微软Copilot和谷歌Gemini则双双上升至35%，Claude也增长到了27%。AIworker分析认为，这主要是因为越来越多的企业开始直接向全员分发自带在现有办公软件里的AI工具，放弃了过去单独采购某款AI的做法。

然而，随着AI工具的选择变得多样化，企业在实际落地时也遇到了不少新麻烦。调查显示，导致AI项目停滞的最大原因是没有**懂得推进的人才**，占比高达34%，其次是繁琐的社内审批流程以及预算依据不足。与此同时，AI的使用阶段也在发生变化：仅靠极少数人私下使用的比例从71%下降到了57%，但全公司推广却推不动的比例则从9%上升到了19%，这充分说明要在整个组织内部顺利推开AI应用并不是一件容易的事。

en.title: AI agents are getting wallets. Is Hong Kong ready for them?
en.summary: Web3 firm Animoca Brands is **testing AI shopping agents** in Hong Kong through its Minds platform, letting bots handle transactions on Visa's network. While **industry forecasts predict massive global growth**, local adoption will likely take years and start slowly in niche communities like digital card collectors.
en.full_summary:
Animoca Brands' agentic AI platform, Minds, is piloting live transactions on Visa's network in Hong Kong, riding a wave of regional interest in automated shopping. Unlike traditional chatbots, these autonomous systems can browse, compare options, and execute payments within preset limits. While global forecasters like Juniper Research and McKinsey project trillions of dollars in future agentic commerce, Animoca COO Minh Do expects mainstream adoption in Hong Kong to be gradual, estimating two years for consumers in their 40s and up to five years for those over 60.

To build trust, Animoca has focused on **security and credential systems**, partnering with Visa, Reap, and Pivota to cap spending by store, amount, and time without exposing raw credit card numbers. Meanwhile, local regulators and major financial institutions are stepping in. The Hong Kong Monetary Authority recently unveiled an advisory group named Sage to govern autonomous AI transactions, while competitors like Mastercard, Alipay, and Tencent are also rolling out their own agentic payment pilots and infrastructure.

zh.title: 当AI助手开始帮人类网购，香港准备好了吗？
zh.summary: Web3企业Animoca Brands旗下的Minds平台正在香港**测试AI购物助手**，让机器人通过Visa网络直接完成支付。虽然**行业预测全球市场巨大**，但本地普及仍需时日，预计将从集换式卡牌等小众领域逐步起步。
zh.full_summary:
Animoca Brands旗下的智能AI平台Minds正在香港通过Visa网络测试实时交易，顺应了当地对自动化购物的热潮。与传统聊天机器人不同，这些自主系统能够在预设限制内浏览商品、对比选项并完成支付。虽然Juniper Research和麦肯锡等机构预测全球代理商务市场规模将达数万亿美元，但Animoca首席运营官Minh Do预计香港的主流普及速度会比较温和，40多岁的消费者大约需要两年，60岁以上则需要五年左右。

为了建立信任，Animoca专注于**安全与凭证系统**，与Visa、Reap和Pivota合作，通过限制店铺、金额和时间来控制支出，同时不暴露真实的信用卡号。与此同时，当地监管机构和各大金融机构也在积极布局。香港金管局最近推出了名为Sage的咨询小组来规范自主AI交易，而万事达卡、支付宝和腾讯等竞争对手也纷纷在香港推出各自的AI代理支付试点和底层基础设施。

en.title: From Raye to Coldplay, How AI Scalpers Are Pricing You Out of Concert Tickets
en.summary: Concert ticketing is facing a major wave of **AI-driven scalping**, where bots generate hundreds of thousands of fake registrations to hoard seats. Industry experts note that while traditional scripts still drive much of the abuse, generative AI accelerates **fraudulent listings** and complex bypass tactics, forcing platforms to rethink their defense strategies.
en.full_summary:
## The Scaling Threat
Major artists like Raye and Coldplay have seen unprecedented demand overwhelmed by automated bot activity, with millions of sign-ups for just thousands of seats. According to industry insiders, while many scalpers still rely on traditional scripts and multiple accounts, generative AI has significantly lowered the barrier for creating convincing **fake booking confirmations** and dynamic pricing markups.

## The Real Ticket Problem
Experts point out that the deeper issue is not just AI-generated fakes, but the resale of **genuine tickets** through informal channels. Secondary marketplaces are now adopting cryptographic proofs, such as zero-knowledge Transport Layer Security (zkTLS), to verify original purchases. However, gaps remain because platforms cannot easily track what happens to a ticket on the original ticketing site after it is sold.

## The Future of AI Agents
As personal AI assistants emerge to help fans book tickets automatically, platforms face the challenge of **distinguishing legitimate agents** from malicious bulk-buying bots. Experts emphasize that future security systems must focus on verifying user identity and intent rather than simply blocking all automated traffic.

zh.title: 从 Raye 到酷玩乐队：AI 黄牛如何让你买不起演唱会门票
zh.summary: 演唱会票务行业正面临**AI黄牛**的严峻挑战，大量机器人伪造数十万个注册信息来抢占座位。行业专家指出，尽管传统脚本仍然是黄牛的主要手段，但生成式AI加速了**虚假凭证**的制作和复杂的绕过手段，迫使各大平台不得不重新审视防范策略。
zh.full_summary:
## 规模化的威胁
像 Raye 和酷玩乐队这样的大牌艺人发现，门票需求正被自动化机器人严重挤压，数百万次的注册争夺区区数万个座位。业内人士指出，尽管许多黄牛依然依赖传统脚本和多个账号，但生成式AI大大降低了制作逼真**虚假预订凭证**以及动态炒作票价的门槛。

## 真实门票的隐患
专家指出，更深层次的问题不仅在于AI伪造的假票，还在于通过非正式渠道转售的**真实门票**。一些二手交易平台正开始采用零知识传输层安全（zkTLS）等密码学证明来验证原始购买记录。然而漏洞依然存在，因为平台很难追踪门票在售出后于原票务网站上的流向。

## AI代理的未来挑战
随着个人AI助手开始帮粉丝自动订票，平台面临着**区分合法代理**与恶意批量抢票机器人的挑战。专家强调，未来的安全系统必须专注于验证用户身份与意图，而不仅仅是简单地屏蔽所有自动化流量。

en.title: Opposition to data centers grows worldwide, from India to Chile, via Ireland and Japan
en.summary: As the AI boom drives a surge in demand, **data centers** are facing growing resistance worldwide. Residents in countries from India to Chile and Scotland are protesting against these massive facilities due to concerns over excessive energy consumption, natural resource depletion, and rising electricity bills.
en.full_summary: According to Le Monde, massive data centers fueling the artificial intelligence revolution are triggering a global backlash that extends far beyond the United States. In places like Scotland, thousands recently demonstrated against the proposed construction of over 20 mega data centers, prompting local governments to mandate stricter environmental impact assessments. Residents globally are increasingly worried that these electricity-hungry and resource-intensive facilities offer limited local job creation while putting severe pressure on local power grids and natural resources.

zh.title: 从印度到智利：全球多地掀起反对建设数据中心的浪潮
zh.summary: 随着人工智能热潮推升算力需求，全球各地对**数据中心**的反对声浪日益高涨。从印度、智利到苏格兰，当地居民纷纷走上街头或发起抵制，主要担心这些巨型设施会大量消耗电力和水资源，并推高电费。
zh.full_summary: 据《世界报》报道，支撑人工智能发展的巨型数据中心正在全球范围内引发广泛抵制。除了美国在多地公投中对数据中心表达不信任外，这种反对情绪已蔓延至全球多国。例如在苏格兰，上千名民众近日集会抗议数十个大型数据中心项目，迫使政府宣布未来必须进行环境影响评估。世界各地的居民普遍担心，这些耗电量巨大的巨型设施不仅无法带来预期的本地就业，还会严重挤占水电资源并推高日常生活成本。

en.title: Fraunhofer IAPT uses ultrasound to remove 3D metal printing supports
en.summary: German research institute **Fraunhofer IAPT** has developed an automated process that uses ultrasound to remove support structures from 3D printed metal parts. According to the institute, the method takes only **a few minutes** and works without manual labor, solving a major bottleneck in metal additive manufacturing.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Process
Removing support structures is traditionally one of the most labor-intensive and hazardous steps in metal additive manufacturing, often exposing workers to fine metal powder. To tackle this, **Fraunhofer IAPT** has created an ultrasonic process that applies high-frequency mechanical vibrations to printed components. By pairing custom-designed support structures with tailored vibration settings, the method concentrates stress where the supports attach, causing them to break away cleanly within **a few minutes**.

## Application and Industry Impact
Originating from the Sonodent research project, the technology is initially being applied in **dental technology** but is designed to scale across other industries. While Fraunhofer IAPT focuses on ultrasonic vibrations, other players are tackling the same bottleneck through robotics, such as Rivelin Robotics, or redesigned breakaway structures, like those from SnowX, highlighting a broader industry push toward automated post-processing.

zh.title: 德国研究机构用超声波轻松去除金属3D打印支撑
zh.summary: 德国应用研究机构 **Fraunhofer IAPT** 开发了一种利用超声波自动去除金属3D打印支撑结构的新技术。据该机构称，这种方法只需几分钟且无需人工操作，有望解决金属3D打印后处理中费时费力的**行业痛点**。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与技术原理
在金属3D打印领域，去除支撑结构一直是一个极其依赖人工、费时费力且存在安全隐患的环节。为了解决这一痛点，德国研究机构 **Fraunhofer IAPT** 开发了一项超声波剥离技术。该技术通过将高频机械振动施加到打印部件上，结合特制的支撑结构设计，使应力集中在支撑连接处，从而让支撑在几分钟内**干净脱落**。

## 行业影响与同类技术
这项技术最初源于 Sonodent 研究项目，目前已率先应用于牙科技术领域，未来有望扩展至更广泛的工业制造中。除了超声波剥离，整个行业也在通过自动化机器人和重新设计易剥离支撑等多种途径，全力攻克金属3D打印的**后处理瓶颈**。

en.title: Banks are cracking down on AI agents and warning users about bot risks
en.summary: Major US financial institutions are **banning third-party bots** from accessing user accounts. They warn that if an **AI agent makes a costly mistake**, the financial burden will fall entirely on the customer.
en.full_summary: As autonomous AI tools become more common for managing personal tasks, major US banks are drawing a hard line against third-party bots attempting to log into customer accounts. Financial institutions are actively blocking these automated tools due to security and operational concerns. Furthermore, banks have issued warnings stating that if an AI agent makes a costly error during a transaction or account management process, the customer will be held strictly responsible for the financial fallout.

zh.title: 银行开始封杀 AI 代理：出事用户自己扛
zh.summary: 美国各大金融机构正在**禁止第三方机器人**登录用户账户。银行方面明确警告，如果 **AI 代理**犯下昂贵的错误，损失将全部由用户自己承担。
zh.full_summary: 随着各种自动化 AI 工具在个人事务管理中越来越常见，美国各大银行开始对试图登录用户账户的第三方机器人采取强硬的封杀态度。出于安全和运营方面的考虑，各大金融机构正在主动拦截这些自动化工具。此外，银行也发出警告称，如果 AI 代理在进行交易或账户管理时出现重大的资金失误，由此产生的经济后果将完全由用户本人承担。
